name: b-side
description: B-Side — write the style and the lyrics, make songs with YuE2 on a Crucible server, and listen while more generate.

scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && node tools/free-port.cjs 4270 && concurrently -k -n ng,electron "ng serve --port 4270" "wait-on http-get://localhost:4270 && electron . --dev"

_crucibleClientNote: The Crucible SDK (@crucible/client) and its installer library (@crucible/bootstrap) are vendored as immutable npm-pack tarballs from the GitHub release (there is no registry publish). Compatibility with a server is the API version on X-Crucible-Api, not this number. To update: gh release download v<ver> -R telltaleatheist/crucible -p 'crucible-client-*.tgz' -p 'crucible-bootstrap-*.tgz' -D vendor, then repoint both dependencies (keep them the same version) and npm install.
